name: microbiome-16s
description: BLAST TSV parsing and conservative taxonomic consensus (existing smartbio engine).

tools.name: BLAST TSV Parser
tools.description: Parse a BLAST TSV into normalized hits (requires a TSV dataset, not FASTA).
tools.unavailable_reason: Requires a BLAST TSV dataset and a locally configured BLAST database; not wired into the MVP planner.

references.title: Basic local alignment search tool
references.verified_by: CrossRef metadata for DOI 10.1016/S0022-2836(05)80360-2 (Altschul et al., J Mol Biol 215(3):403-410, 1990), checked 2026-11-24

limitations: The adapter parses an existing BLAST TSV; it does not run a new BLAST search.
Parsed similarity is not proof of taxonomic identity.
Malformed TSV rows are excluded from the analysis and reported as input quality flags, not fabricated hits.

tools.name: Taxonomic Consensus
tools.description: Conservative per-query taxonomic verdict from parsed BLAST hits.
tools.unavailable_reason: Requires parsed BLAST TSV hits from a locally configured database; not wired into the MVP planner.

references.title: Basic local alignment search tool
references.verified_by: CrossRef metadata for DOI 10.1016/S0022-2836(05)80360-2 (Altschul et al., J Mol Biol 215(3):403-410, 1990), checked 2026-11-24

references.title: Towards a taxonomic coherence between average nucleotide identity and 16S rRNA gene sequence similarity for species demarcation of prokaryotes
references.note: Bibliographic record exists (PubMed 24505072), but a 98.65% 16S identity cutoff is a screening proposal, not a universal species boundary; this claim is deliberately not marked verified.

limitations: 16S identity thresholds are screening references, not universal species boundaries.
A verdict interprets BLAST similarity evidence; it is not proof of species identity or a clinical diagnosis.
No network taxonomy lookup is performed; only the supplied TSV and optional local taxonomy map are used.
Queries without hits remain unresolved and are reported as such rather than assigned a taxon.
